description.en: Every two seconds quell 5 percentage points of peril and vent 5 percentage points of heat. Unsupported resources are skipped.
description.zh-cn: 每 2 秒消退 5 个百分点的危机值和热量；角色或武器不具有相应资源时跳过。
description.zh-tw: 每 2 秒消退 5 個百分點的危機值和熱量；角色或武器不具有相應資源時跳過。
